answer.reason: Events of the story took place in the wilderness of Zin: Israel's arrival at Kadesh where Miriam died, and the rebellion at the waters of Meribah.

clauses.english: was where Miriam died and was buried, when Israel came to Kadesh
clauses.quote: Miriam died there, and was buried there

clauses.english: was where Moses and Aaron rebelled against the LORD's commandment at the water of Meribah
clauses.quote: ye rebelled against my commandment in the desert of Zin

doubts: NUM 13:21 (spies searching from Zin), NUM 33:36, NUM 34:3 and JOS 15:1 only give route or boundary, so left out.
PSA 29:8 names the wilderness of Kadesh in a figure of the LORD's voice, not an event, so left out.
